description: Annex I Theme Transport Networks - Roads - RoadServiceArea is a dataset listed in Geoportal of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.inspire.geoportail.lu. This dataset contains the road service areas of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg. The dataset is structured according to the INSPIRE Annex I Theme - Transport networks. The data has been derived from the BD-LTC Database and contains road service areas without further network information. Coverage: LU. Its keywords include Network, Roads, Transport networks, INSPIRE. The listing shows 4 download or service links in OGCFEAT, WMS, ATOM, GML. The listing shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lu.
